scenes.say: Arabica or robusta? Here's what changes in your cup.
Arabica is usually sweeter and softer. Robusta is earthier, with more bite.
Robusta usually feels heavier and rounder. Arabica feels lighter.
Crema is the foam on espresso. Robusta usually gives more.
Is robusta always cheap and bad? False. Quality varies by farm.
Check your espresso bag. Does it list robusta? Then taste for body and crema.
Arabica for nuance, robusta for body. Does your blend list robusta?
